Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/test/06-interactive-io.scm:
     1	;; Test 6: Interactive I/O with read
     2	
     3	(display "Interactive calculator")
     4	(newline)
     5	(display "Enter two numbers and an operation (+, -, *, /)")
     6	(newline)
     7	
     8	(display "First number: ")
     9	(define num1 (read))
    10	(display "Second number: ")
    11	(define num2 (read))
    12	(display "Operation (+, -, *, /): ")
    13	(define op (read))
    14	
    15	(define result
    16	  (cond ((eq? op '+) (+ num1 num2))
    17	        ((eq? op '-) (- num1 num2))
    18	        ((eq? op '*) (* num1 num2))
    19	        ((eq? op '/) (/ num1 num2))
    20	        (else 'invalid-operation)))
    21	
    22	(display "Result: ")
    23	(display result)
    24	(newline)
    25	
    26	;; Mini REPL
    27	(display "Mini expression evaluator (type 'quit to exit)")
    28	(newline)
    29	
    30	(define (mini-repl)
    31	  (display "> ")
    32	  (let ((expr (read)))
    33	    (if (eq? expr 'quit)
    34	        (display "Goodbye!")
    35	        (progn
    36	          (display "You entered: ")
    37	          (display expr)
    38	          (newline)
    39	          ;; In a real REPL, we'd evaluate expr here
    40	          (mini-repl)))))
    41	
    42	;; Comment out to avoid infinite loop in batch mode
    43	;; (mini-repl)
